title: OXYGEN Unibox
description: Use OXYGEN Messages and the Unibox to find, read, classify, tag, archive, draft and reply in existing email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp conversations, send one direct email, start one WhatsApp chat or delete a sent LinkedIn message. Net-new LinkedIn outreach uses Sequences.

reply-to-meeting.title: Turn replies into booked meetings
reply-to-meeting.label: Replies to meetings
reply-to-meeting.summary: Answer every reply from one list, book more calls, and bring 'not now' leads back.
reply-to-meeting.prompt: Help me turn replies into booked meetings: one queue for my email and LinkedIn replies, drafts I review and send, the CRM updated when a call gets booked, and the 'not now' replies brought back when it's time.
trigger_phrases: I get replies but they never turn into meetings
Help me handle my inbound replies faster
Book more meetings from the replies I already have
Log booked calls in my CRM automatically
What do I do with 'circle back next quarter' replies?
Bring deferred leads back when they're ready
reply-to-meeting.business_case: Replies scatter across email and LinkedIn and go cold before anyone books a call, and 'not now' replies get lost. One list with suggested answers, a booking link in every answer, automatic booking logs and a dated slow lane turn more of them into meetings.
reply-to-meeting.outcome: Your mailbox connected, the replies waiting on you in one list, answers sent with a booking link after your yes, Cal.com bookings logged on the CRM record, and 'not now' people in a lane with a revisit date.
reply-to-meeting.leading_metric: share of positive replies that book a call, and hours from a reply to your answer
reply-to-meeting.benchmark: A same-business-day answer with a booking link typically books 15-30% of positive replies; a day's delay or no link roughly halves that. A dated 'not now' lane typically wins back 5-15% of deferred leads within 6-12 months.

effort.time_to_value: first reply answered the same session once the mailbox is connected
effort.cadence: daily reply check; weekly look at who is due a revisit

credits.pilot: 0 per reply; the mailbox it needs reserves 100 credits a month
credits.full: 100 a month per mailbox, 3,400 a month per LinkedIn account; replies, booking logs and the not-now lane 0

prerequisites.detail: A paid plan, from $49 a month, to connect the mailbox or LinkedIn account; credits for each account's first month (100 for a mailbox, 3,400 for a LinkedIn account)
Your own Gmail or Microsoft 365 mailbox connected, so replies reach the list; it reserves 100 credits a month
Company, offer and ICP filled, so suggested answers sound like you
